BE IT ORDAINED         BY THE CITY COUNCIL             OF THE CITY OF          CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townliouse and Multi-Unit

District and B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on

Map No. 4-J in the area bounded by


       West Roosevelt Road; South Independence Boulevard; a line 150 feet
       South of and parallel to West Roosevelt Road; and the alley next west
       of and parallel to South Independence Boulevard,


to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.
